content: Orgahi-Orha'a Niwra Nat niohor memna Abraham pesiayni
Lera ida ne Orgahi Niwra Nat niohora memna Abraham pesiayni pede Nakot la Niwra: “Abraham ee!”
“Mua'ala Isaka, a'namu muanke' memeh mak o ralammu nala de, pa mlia'awa Moria lowanni, ne mhi'a Isaka di pa nhi'a hoihoi-tantiani la wo'ora id wawannu, maka pena Atiutga tiy o'a.”

Repardoin yawyawar ma'ta de Abrahama namat wa, nkenia keledaini wniowni, na'nama npolga hopopanni riy woru me Isaka. Noka naklihir targa au pa nodi wal lia hoihoi-tantiani re tniunnu-nhiaranni, noka rwaran pa rla'awa gen miaka Orgahi Nakot targa la.
La'pa lera wotellu de, Abrahama nran matni pa namkek nana gen die ndella olietni.
Noka Abrahama nakot la hopopanni re rora niwra: “Miora keledai di pa mdien nek la handi. Agora a a'nu di pa amla'awa hande. Amla mtunga hoihoi-tantiani la Orgahi, nhor diemade amawal tiy miy.”
Noka Abrahama na'ala au maka ralla rtunga hoihoi-tantiani re, pa nlapra la a'nani wawayanni wawannu, mere la' limni ralamni de Abraham nih'ru nana ai me ta'wa. Emkadella pa rrora rala' wut rewre'wa.
Noka Isaka nakot la amni: “Ama.” Abrahama nwahla: “Hya' ame?” Noma natiana niwra: “Mai handi de ai nora au er olek la wa, mere dum a'na etla meni pa rhi'a la hoihoi-tantiani tniunu-nhiarna?”
Abrahama nwahla: “Ama, Orgahi pena Nalla dum a'na pa rhi'a la hoihoi-tantiani tniunu-nhiarna la Orgahi.” Emkadella pa rrora rala' rewre'wa.
Rte'ela gen miaka Orgahi Nakot targa la. Noka Abraham nariria katri'ana la' hande, nwatiernu au me nwutga a'nani, noka nlapra la katri'ana wawannu la'a au wawannu.
Nhor nioka Abraham netar limni pa na'ala ta'wa na'nama niwa nala rotna Isaka tiernu.
Mtatande nekpa Orgahi hopopanni Nden nek la lyanti pa Nhaun nohora Abraham, Niwra: “Hei! Abraham ee!”

Noka Orgahi hopopanni Nal lirni: “Yana! Yana mpuenna a'namu de, yana mhi' la'a-mhi' maiya. Dodo'ondi de Agat niohor oleka wa, de mu'unni-mumta'ata A'u, yoma ralammu edon werwerta la muala a'na memehemu de mai A'u.”
Noka Abraham nran gaini pa namkek nana duma ltiata ida mak dudallu nha'ar tar lia ruwnu-ahla ralamni. Abrahama la na'ala dum de pa nhi'a la hoihoi-tantiani, na nhernia a'nani.

Hade pede Abrahama nhi' gen die pa nwawa: “Orgahi Nwahi' targa olek wa.” Onnila hade pede la'pa nmai lia dodo'ondi mana riy riwra: “La'a wo'or hananni mak Orgahi Nhopan pa Abraham nala hoihoi-tantiani de, hota Uplerlawna Nwahi' targa hya' maka rakleha.”
La'pa re'eni wornu wa, pa Orgahi hopopanni Ndella lyanti pa Nhaun la Abrahama,
Niwra: “Aliokar de Awuet la A na'nu, de yoma onnila omliernohora A li'ru, ne ralammu edon werwerta la muala a'na memehemu de mai A'u,

pa hota Agala ra'u-pa'lu tiy o' pa harahu, ne ghi'a duratmu-waitmu re harahu memna emolmolla wtion no'a lyanti me emeka en nio'a eni wawannu, ne duratmu-waitmu hota rodi plolli-rtaryatnu la arwalli re letni-ruhunni.
Onnila o duratmu-waitmu na'nama rimormiori nohkeran di rlernana yara'a-yapalu. Hari honona hota Aghi'a onnila omutlina-mutailla li'ru-tu'nu.”
Nhor nioka Abrahama nawal lia hopopanni re rora, noka rewre'wa pa rawal lia Bersyeba. Noma Abrahama nhol lia hande wa.
Nahor duratni-waitni
Lera ida ne Abrahama nlernana kota-de'eta riwra: “Yermu Milka mana na'a'na nan walia a'na muanke'a la hyalmu Nahora.

De Nahora a'nani yanulu de nwawa Usa, mak klernohora Usa de, Busa, mak klernohora Busa, Kemuel, mak klernohora Kemuel de, Kesed, mak klernohora Kesed, Haso, mak klernohora Haso, Pildasy, mak klernohora Pildasy, Yidlaf, mak klernohora Yidlaf, Betuel, gari hoho'a hade. Hari honon rde Milka na'a'na nan la Nahora. Ne Kemuel nlawlawan lola pa hota nhi' am la makdena Aram.” Noka Betuel na'a'na Ribka.
Ne Nahora hawa liahunu Reuma na'a'na nan wali a'na muanke'a re doma, yanulu nwawa Tebah, mak klernohora Tebah, Gaham, mak klernohora Gaham, Tahasy, mak klernohora Tahasy, Maakha.
